description: Get the link to Lawyerd's intake form — the way to actually start a takedown. Read-only: returns the link plus what to prepare and what happens next; it creates nothing and files nothing. The content owner opens the link in a browser and sends the request; before any notice is filed, Lawyerd checks ownership and the owner signs a one-time authorization (the one step that legally requires a human). Requests targeting lawful criticism, reviews or journalism are declined at intake. Documentation: https://mcp.lawyerd.net/.
